stem.text: A ripple tank contains water at a constant depth.
A water wave of constant frequency travels towards a gap in a barrier placed in the ripple tank.

stem.alt: Diagram of straight wavefronts travelling from the left towards a barrier with a gap. Beyond the gap the wavefronts are shown as arcs.

stem.text: Which diagram represents the wave before and after the barrier?

A.alt: Diagram of straight wavefronts on the left of a barrier with a gap, and short wavefronts drawn on the right of the barrier as straight lines.

B.alt: Diagram of straight wavefronts on the left of a barrier with a gap, and three arcs drawn on the right of the barrier.

C.alt: Diagram of straight wavefronts on the left of a barrier with a gap, and three arcs drawn on the right of the barrier.

D.alt: Diagram of straight wavefronts on the left of a barrier with a gap, and three larger arcs drawn on the right of the barrier.
